meta.title: Input prediction
meta.description: When the composer is empty, predicts your next message from the current conversation and shows it as the editor's placeholder. Press Tab to use it or Esc to dismiss it; nothing is sent automatically. Turn it on or off with the icon beside the model selector below the editor: grey is off, dark is on. While on, recent conversation text is sent to your configured model, with additional usage costs. Supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 only; incompatible input layouts disable prediction.
